title: Frontier AI lab releases new multimodal reasoning model
text: Frontier AI lab today announced the release of a new multimodal reasoning model capable of solving complex competitive mathematics and software engineering benchmarks. The model exhibits a 40% reduction in inference cost and introduces novel chain-of-thought verification mechanisms.
